description: A small white two-drawer box sits on a red bedspread in front of you, with a white sheet draped behind it. The left hand steadies the box as the right hand moves in to grip the top drawer’s knob, pulls the drawer straight outward, then lifts it free and sets it down to the right, changing the box from a two-hand object to a left-hand object while the removed drawer becomes a right-hand object and is released onto the bed.
